self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: People of the Faltering Light (R5): using an Elemental Skill increases Energy Recharge by 48% for 10s.

en.flavor: A national treasure of Byakuyakoku stored in the Dainichi Mikoshi. With the coming of the Serpent God, this item was used to notarize great oaths and wishes.

refinements.1: Increases Energy Recharge by <r>24%</r> for 10s after using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.2: Increases Energy Recharge by <r>30%</r> for 10s after using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.3: Increases Energy Recharge by <r>36%</r> for 10s after using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.4: Increases Energy Recharge by <r>42%</r> for 10s after using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.5: Increases Energy Recharge by <r>48%</r> for 10s after using an Elemental Skill.
